nodes.description: Map.keys: address[] array holding all inserted keys of the IterableMapping
Map.values: mapping(address => uint256) storing the value associated with each key
Map.indexOf: mapping(address => uint256) storing the position of each key inside Map.keys

get(Map storage,address) view: returns the stored value for a key

size(Map storage) view: returns the number of keys held by the mapping
set(Map storage,address,uint256): updates an existing value or inserts a new key/value pair
remove(Map storage,address): deletes a key using the swap-and-pop pattern over Map.keys
